video_title: Ja Morant: I'M BACK HOME | Hall of Fame Moment (S4E1)

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant reflects on his desire to play more for the Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I'm not happy that I was not able to be out there as much as I would like to
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say I'm not happy because I'm able to do what I love at the highest level every day. But I'm not happy that I was not able to be out there as much as I would like to for my team and I'm not happy that we weren't able to achieve our goal. But like I said earlier, there's positive in everything and I know what this all season looks like for me already and it just makes me excited to go into the next season.

quotes.speaker: Matt McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt McMahon on Ja Morant's generational talent and impact
quotes.excerpt: Ja is such a generational talent both on and off the floor
quotes.quote: Ja is such a generational talent both on and off the floor. To get to be here and celebrate with him here tonight is really special. He's had an incredible impact not just on Murray State University, but on me and my family. So we're incredibly grateful for everything he's done in our life and to get to be here to celebrate this great accomplishment tonight is a lot of fun.

quotes.speaker: Matt McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt McMahon recounts Ja Morant's air guitar celebration
quotes.excerpt: He played the air guitar for an entire defensive possession in front of the EKU bench
quotes.quote: There's a great story behind this picture. We're playing Eastern Kentucky at home and Ja hits a three. This is back in the air guitar celebration days. He played the air guitar for an entire defensive possession in front of the EKU bench until the official finally teed him up. So I had a couple words with Ja about that. Very next possession, he comes down and gets an and-one and comes over there and gives us a bear hug on the bench. So it's definitely a memorable moment for all of us.

quotes.speaker: Jeff Bidwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeff Bidwell on Ja Morant's immediate impact at Murray State
quotes.excerpt: Ja came in as a freshman and was obviously really, really good
quotes.quote: Ja came in as a freshman and was obviously really, really good. His talent is just unlike something so many of us have ever seen. Everybody in Murray knew he was a really good player. He was a leader. He made the guys' culture so much better than I had ever seen it.

quotes.speaker: Lindy Suiter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lindy Suiter on Ja Morant's unmatched competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: You talk about all the stuff Ja does that's so great, his competitiveness is on another level
quotes.quote: You talk about all the stuff Ja does that's so great, his competitiveness is on another level. He wants to win bad. As a freshman in 2017-18, Ja showed flashes of his greatness throughout the season with his unguardability on his way to earning All-Conference honors. His freshman year was unbelievable. He put up statistics his freshman year that were honestly unheard of here at Murray State.

quotes.speaker: Sawyer Lawson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sawyer Lawson on Ja Morant's ability to impact winning
quotes.excerpt: Ja just knew he needed to come in and affect winning and affect change
quotes.quote: Ja just knew he needed to come in and affect winning and affect change, and that's 100% what he did. Ja Morant put Murray State in everybody's living room and that was just so awesome. And this is a guy who walks the walk and talks the talk on the court and off the court. He was willing to do whatever it took to win.

quotes.speaker: Jeff Bidwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeff Bidwell on Ja Morant's national rise
quotes.excerpt: This guy was becoming a flat-out star on a national stage
quotes.quote: He left us after his freshman year in March and we didn't see him for seven months. And to be able to experience that year, it was just surreal to watch him. This guy was becoming a flat-out star on a national stage. The Ja Morant effect was real.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Thomas on Ja Morant's growth and commitment to Murray State
quotes.excerpt: Ja grew up like that just because he liked it, but I never had like my own team
quotes.quote: Ja grew up like that just because he liked it, but I never had like my own team with that. So like now that I'm older and know what's going on and all, once I got older I stopped moving for him. I know the reason like see North Carolina, South Carolina had a football team back in the day. Yeah, we, yeah, the Grizzlies. So yeah.
